comment: Every decision spec in app/specs is built here with its full model, or awaiting the builder, with the reason the builder cannot take it yet. The awaiting list only shrinks (BS-01).
name: me
title: me
purpose: A Prism of its owner, run only in the owner's browser: it differentiates what reaches the owner into parts and routes each where it belongs.

awaiting.chronology: its fields are all numbers, so no choice field can factor its 14-rule chain and omega cannot split it; it needs a comparison decision tree in the builder
awaiting.curate: a keyword facet of more than eight fields (tools/holon/gen.py); the builder takes at most eight
awaiting.dest: a keyword facet of more than eight fields (tools/dest/gen.py); the builder takes at most eight
awaiting.holon: a keyword facet whose fields are not yet number or choice fields (tools/holon/gen.py)
awaiting.kappa: a keyword facet whose fields are not yet number or choice fields (tools/kappa/gen.py)
awaiting.resonance: a keyword facet whose fields are not yet number or choice fields (tools/facet/gen.py)
awaiting.router: a keyword facet whose fields are not yet number or choice fields (tools/facet/gen.py)
awaiting.uorc: a keyword facet whose fields are not yet number or choice fields (tools/uorc/gen.py)
